title_zh: 澄清悬疑剧线索后继续排练

scenario.goal_zh: 澄清虚构案件的角色关系并确定继续排练的位置。

context_zh: 两位演员讨论虚构侦探剧中钥匙线索与逮捕发生的顺序。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Why does my detective ask about the office key here? Has the arrest already happened?

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: Not yet. The key is the clue that makes her question the assistant's story.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: So she is suspicious, but she has not proved anything.

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: Exactly. The assistant says he has never been inside, then recognizes the key.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: I was playing it as if she already knew he was guilty. I should sound curious instead.

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: Yes. Save the stronger reaction for the next scene.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Let us start again from your line about the locked office.

sentences.speaker: Martin
sentences.text: Ready. I will give you a moment to look at the key before I answer.
